content.text: Grant’s army defeated Bragg at Chattanooga: Sherman seized Missionary Ridge’s north end, Hooker captured Lookout Mountain, and Thomas’s troops stormed the ridge, forcing Bragg to retreat to Dalton. Grant then fought Lee through the Wilderness, Spotsylvania, North Anna, and Cold Harbor before crossing the James and investing Petersburg. Sherman advanced from Chattanooga through Georgia, taking Atlanta, marching from Atlanta to Savannah, capturing Fort McAllister and Savannah, then moving through South Carolina and North Carolina to join Grant. Hood invaded Tennessee, losing disastrously at Franklin and Nashville. Sheridan defeated Early in the Shenandoah at Winchester, Fisher’s Hill, and Cedar Creek. Petersburg fell after Five Forks, Richmond was evacuated, and Lee surrendered to Grant at Appomattox on April 9, 1865. Johnston later surrendered to Sherman, ending the Confederacy.
